usageNotes: Use this to update the DNS resolver configuration (nameservers and search domain) for a specific PDM node; changes take effect immediately on the node's /etc/resolv.conf without a reboot. The caller must hold System.Modify on the node's system/network/dns ACL path. Pass the digest from get_nodes_node_dns to guard against concurrent modifications — the call will fail if the config has changed since you last read it.

examples.summary: Set primary and secondary DNS servers with a search domain on a node

tips: All DNS parameters are optional — omit any you do not want to change, or use the 'delete' array to remove dns2/dns3/search without touching the others.
IPv6 nameserver addresses are accepted; the validation pattern covers both IPv4 and IPv6 formats.
The 'options' field maps to freeform lines in resolv.conf (e.g. 'timeout:2 attempts:3') — use sparingly and only for content you would manually place in that file.
Returns null on success; any error (bad IP format, wrong digest, insufficient privilege) surfaces as an HTTP 4xx response.
